name: Mèimó de Màoxiǎn Shēnghuó
summary: This is a different magical world, where adventurers don't have to brush up and down, and all the levels and rewards are earned by opening all the treasure chests in the world. The player will act as the leader of a treasure chest hunter squad and find the treasure chest to defeat the BOSS.
